A rectangle has area = 1,200 cm² and perimeter = 140 cm. Find its dimensions.
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 2(l+b) = 140 → l+b = 70. Area = l×b = 1,200. So l and b are roots of x²−70x+1,200=0 → (x−60)(x−20)=0 → l=60, b=20.

A rectangular piece of cardboard is 20 cm × 15 cm. A square of side 3 cm is cut from each corner. Area remaining =
questions.explanation: Original area = 20×15 = 300 cm². Four squares cut = 4 × (3×3) = 4×9 = 36 cm². Remaining = 300 − 36 = 264 cm².

questions.question: Which has larger area: a square with side 10 cm, or a rectangle 13 cm × 8 cm?
questions.explanation: Square = 10² = 100 cm². Rectangle = 13 × 8 = 104 cm². Rectangle is larger by 4 cm².

questions.question: A path of width 2 m runs around the inside of a rectangular park (30 m × 20 m). Area of the path =
questions.explanation: Outer area = 30×20 = 600 m². Inner area (excluding path) = (30−4)×(20−4) = 26×16 = 416 m². Path area = 600 − 416 = 184 m².
